lane: Agent governance and offline release evidence
goal: Prepare scoped project release guidance and a dependency-free read-only evidence checker; preserve current migration blockers and dirty work.
successCriteria: Owner packet separates documentation updated from product and market readiness.
Fail-closed local gate rejects changed hashes, wrong target/org/project, missing evidence or stale approval.
Staging remains in existing Free organization; only market-ready end-user production belongs in Pro after exact cost approval.
untouchedSurfaces: Mobile/Admin/backend runtime and database source stay unchanged.
No secrets, personal data, live services, installs, commits, pushes, deployments or billing mutations.
Dirty admin-runtime-parity skill changes and unrelated manifest entries remain intact.

impact.entryPoint: Agent instructions route to a local release runbook; app navigation is unchanged.
impact.dataWrite: Only scoped Markdown, JSON profile/skill metadata and offline validator files; no user rows or personal saves.
impact.backendContract: No backend API change; existing blocked ledger and synthetic schema rehearsal rules remain authoritative.
impact.adminVisibility: Plain-language private owner packet; no public/help corpus or Admin runtime change.
impact.privacySafety: Checker prohibits credential paths and uses sanitized evidence; production credentials remain outside agent sessions.
impact.observability: Four truthful evidence states; no remote CI or enforcement claimed and no fabricated live test.
impact.rollback: Retain exact before/after delta and compare-and-swap hashes; reverse only this scoped change after conflict review.

canonicalContracts: docs/release/release-profile.json declares project mode, reviewed organization boundaries, empty cloud target allowlist, current blockers and required checks.
scripts/release-evidence.mjs verifies exact bytes; it never deploys or grants external authority.

skillReview.name: nilaza-plan-qc
skillReview.evidence: Add release-control reference and routing while retaining existing dirty admin-runtime-parity contents and metadata.

dependencyReview.evidence: No dependency additions or provider API implementation; use existing Node and owner-specified policy, treating dated cost/account reports as unverified planning scenarios.

securityReview.authzRls: No access policy changes; runbook requires grants/RLS/Storage/RPC/view negative A/B and revoked-token evidence before future release.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Only sanitized source guidance and synthetic fixtures; never copy production user data into staging.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No env contents or secrets read; checker rejects credential file paths, production secrets excluded from agent and untrusted PR sessions.
securityReview.externalInput: Treat manifest/approval as untrusted JSON; reject traversal, unsafe file records and unapproved evidence states.
securityReview.dependencies: No install or new dependency; portable built-in Node checker and tests reviewed in the task workspace first.
securityReview.migrationRelease: Preserve foreign-MCY blocked ledger, empty cloud target allowlist and owner-approved market/provision/release gates.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop on concurrent file hash changes, unsafe target path, unmet filesystem approval or validator regressions; no live release authorized.

workingTreeReview.note: Existing scoped dirty manifest changes are preserved; unrelated Admin/runtime edits stay outside this change. All mutations use expected-before hashes.

managerTestPath: Read the Vietnamese owner packet, select a synthetic candidate, and confirm that absent approval or cloud target blocks; no product release is implied.
residualRisk: Evidence checks cannot prove truth, owner identity, remote enforcement or a complete dynamic dependency graph; installed skill synchronization remains deferred under no-install scope.
